description: Environmental Impact Assessment Screening Opinion under Regulation 6 of The Town and Country Planning (Environmental Impact Assessment) Regulations 2017 (the 'EIA Regulations') for the erection of 258 new homes within 11 new buildings ranging in height from 3 to 6 storeys and a row of detached houses along each of the northern and western boundaries, flexible community hub space at ground floor level; creation of new vehicular and pedestrian access ways at ground level alongside private and communal amenity space, children's playspace and public spaces at ground level; provision of 94 residential car parking spaces and 302 cycle spaces across ground and the undercroft car park.
site_name: The Huntsman Sports Club, Manor Way, Blackheath, Greenwich SE3 9AJ
